description: This file is the entry point for a React-based web application. It imports React, ReactDOM, global CSS styles, and the main App component. It initializes the React application by rendering the App component inside a root DOM element with id 'root', wrapped in React.StrictMode for highlighting potential issues.

methods.name: createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the component tree, attaching it to the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM, in this case the App component wrapped in React.StrictMode.
